jobs_results.title: QA Manager
jobs_results.description:
NTT Data somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes y los diferentes sectores en los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad.

Nuestra esencia nos ha llevado a la vanguardia de la tecnología, a romper paradigmas y a brindar las soluciones que realmente se corresponden a las necesidades de cada cliente. Nuestro talento nos ha hecho poder decir con orgullo que somos una de las 6 empresas TOP de tecnologías en el mundo.

El equipo de especialistas de calidad de NTT DATA está creciendo cada día más, gracias a la colaboración con el gran número de clientes que confían en nosotros y sus variados proyectos. Por ello, queremos que tú tengas la oportunidad de unirte a nuestro equipo, ¿quieres formar parte de este reto?

En nuestra oficina de Madrid buscamos responsables de proyecto en el área de calidad capaces de liderar servicios de Quality Services en grandes clientes. Se requieren... profesionales con al menos 6 años de experiencia en diferentes proyectos de testing, capaces de liderar equipos multidisciplinares, realizar asesorías de calidad a cliente y reportar a capa de ejecutiva.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
• Identificar las necesidades en cuento a calidad/pruebas se refiere en un cliente.
• Proponer soluciones de testing o metodológicas en base a su experiencia.
• Definir estrategias de pruebas.
• Interpretar políticas de prueba establecidas por cliente.
• Tener un conocimiento básico sobre automatización de pruebas y pruebas de rendimiento.
• Liderar de un equipo de testing y gestión de personas.
• Gestionar las necesidades del cliente.
• Reportar a capa de ejecutiva unidad de testing.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?
• Un plan de formación adaptado a tu experiencia profesional y a tu medida, dándote la oportunidad de formarte y certificarte en diferentes áreas de conocimiento.
• Trabajar en proyectos nacionales e internacionales con empresas de gran prestigio
• Plan de carrera personalizado acorde a tus motivaciones e inquietudes profesionales que te permita desarrollar tu talento.
• Flexibilidad horaria.
• Beneficios sociales

¡NTT DATA es tu sitio! Porque hemos obtenido en España, por 9º año consecutivo, la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas en las que trabajar, gracias a nuestro compromiso por el talento. Únete a un equipo que apuesta por el desarrollo integral de sus profesionales, elige el modelo de trabajo que mejor se adapte a ti, y colabora en un entorno diverso, donde cada persona tiene su propia singularidad

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The multi-screen streaming video and the interactive TV space is growing rapidly. Accedo delivers rich media apps on multiple platforms ranging from Smart TVs, gaming consoles, Set Top Boxes, Roku, Apple TV, Android TV, Chromecast, Web, Smart phones, tablets and more. Accedo is a leading company in this sector and is hiring at multiple locations (Madrid, Stockholm, London, Guadalajara, Budapest).

At Accedo, you will be part of a diverse and multi-disciplined development team, gaining exposure to cutting-edge technologies. This means working with some of the largest global media brands in the industry, e.g. Netflix, Spotify, BBC, HBO and Deutsche Telekom, just to name a few. Working in a highly collaborative and international environment, you will help transform requirements and designs into high performing feature rich applications on a wide variety of web based platforms and devices.

Who are we?

We are Accedo and have more than ten years of experience helping hundreds of TV... platform operators, broadcasters, media companies, and consumer electronics manufacturers across the globe to design, deliver and manage the next generation video user experience across a vast range of connected devices.

Accedo offers a truly global working environment, with offices all over the world, including Stockholm, London, New York, Silicon Valley, Sydney, Hong Kong, Guadalajara, Toronto and more.

At the end of the day, our employees are what make us who we are, which means we work hard to create a good working environment with plenty of opportunities to grow and develop within Accedo, wherever they want to be in the world. We are on a journey, and are always open to ideas and individuals that want to contribute to making that journey a success.

This position is aimed at Accedo's growing Quality Assurance Engineering team in Madrid. At Accedo you will be part of a diverse and multi-disciplined team, gain exposure to cutting edge technologies and can work with some of the largest global media brands in the industry. Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will help transforming requirements and designs into high performing and feature rich applications on a wide variety of web based platforms and devices.

Objective of role: you will be primarily responsible for project testing of Accedo’s multimedia and streaming applications. You will play a key role in ensuring the quality of media applications and games being developed for world famous brands. The role will involve a close relationship with software development teams in Accedo.

Main tasks
• Defining, developing and deploying quality assurance initiatives throughout entire software life cycle, including development, enhancements or maintenance
• Provide appropriate planning and execution in regression testing, performance testing, integration testing, and other non-functional testing to ensure successful application deployment
• Designing and executing test plans, cases and scripts to ensure that products of exceptional quality is delivered, aligned with business objectives on various platforms such as mobile, web, smart TV and game console
• Collaborate in a cross-function delivery team to ensure that all aspects of quality are actively discussed and addressed during the delivery process
• Work with clients to help convey issues around quality and build a relationship surrounding QA on the respective project
• Updating and maintaining best QA procedures and standards, including test planning, test data preparation and test automation
• Defining and analysing performance objectives and measuring against data QA compliance metrics and ensuring targets
• Lead quality initiatives on a project managing multiple platforms, interacting with customers on a daily basis, working closely with developers, Business Analyst, Project manager and Product Owners.
• Define the test strategy, automation strategy and write test scripts and automate UI and API
• Provide input to the QA Manager/Team lead for all QA related activities and dependencies
• Bachelor degree or higher in Engineering or related discipline. Preference will be given to Computer/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science degree holders
• 2-3 years of experience in the field of Software Quality Assurance along with experience in design, development, and implementation of quality assurance standards for software product testing
• Strong experience working with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
• Strong knowledge of software Quality Assurance best practices and methodologies
• Strong experience in software Quality Control, and testing areas
• Good English language skills. You should be able to communicate in English with colleagues and customers.
• Experience in QA Automation is a big plus
• Experience with statistical analysis and reporting techniques
• Self-motivated, passionate, responsible and a good team player
• Excellent analytical, problem solving, and documentation skills
• Excellent communicator, detail oriented and quality focused
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
• Streaming media technology experience is a plus
• Preference will be given to candidates with automation experience
• Experience from the Software industry is mandatory

Appfire empowers today’s knowledge workers to plan and deliver their best work. Appfire’s portfolio of top-selling apps serves more than 20,000 customers – including 55% of the Fortune 500. As a product-led company, Appfire identifies gaps in industries serving knowledge workers and then builds solutions that drive productivity and efficiency.

Appfire continues to grow exponentially, with teams spanning 20+ countries. Job Purpose And Overview

Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer and contribute to the success of our Dataplane and Dashboard Hub family apps (Data Center and Cloud apps). We are a globally recognized team serving enterprise customers such as Amazon, Boeing, Blizzard, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, VMware, and Visa.

You’ll be doing software testing of our Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and

monday.com | A new way of working apps and collaborating with the team to make sure we continue to provide high-quality products to our customers. You’ll be testing new features, improvements and bug fixes. You will collaborate with the team to help design and improve test plans, tooling for automatic testing, and QA procedures.

What You’ll Do
• Rapidly gain functional knowledge of Jira (mainly), Confluence, Bitbucket and
• monday.com | A new way of working , both as user and administrator, and deep functional knowledge of our products.
• Contribute to the agile development process by testing software solutions and providing rapid feedback to developers and product management.
• Improve testing coverage for unit testing and regression testing, manual and automatic.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing strategy, processes, and tools.
• Work on internal tooling to improve and scale the validation process, including automatic generation of test data, automatic deployment of reference environments, and automatic testing.
• Maintain and enhance our reference test databases/environments.
• Provide product support assistance.

What We Would Like To See
• An autonomous and self-organizing team member, capable of achieving assigned objectives.
• Strong skills in defining, writing, and executing test cases and test scenarios.
• Excellent analytical and observation skills, with attention to detail.
• Ability to understand complex software products and their usage.
• A curious and adaptable mind, capable of learning while delivering value.
• Engineering degree in software QA, software/computer science, or related domain.
• Solid written and verbal English communication is mandatory.
• 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Knowledge of Atlassian products such as Jira would be a plus.

What We Offer
• Every Appfire employee is eligible for company equity
• Remote work flexibility from home office
• Private health insurance
• 25 working day of paid annual leave
• Reduced summer hours: From July 1st until the end of August we work 6 hours per day.
• Flexible bank holidays policy: Allowing you to exchange a government-set public holiday for a more convenient time off.
• Annual sport allowance
